pull_request.title: Calorimeter: LAr ECAL endcaps and layout prototype
pull_request.head: codex/layout002-lar-endcaps
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Complete **LAYOUT-002** as a separately documented ALLEGRO-style LAr alternative to SiW. Add three physical turbine wheels on both ends, cold electronics/support/cooling proxies, larger HCAL and service envelopes, and a README-linked R–Z view beside LAYOUT-001.

**Merge after #73:** this PR is stacked on its barrel/common-service branch. The tracker and proposed inner 3 T solenoid are retained. No external FCC/key4hep package or factory is imported.

## Geometry and service space

- Three wheels, 384/720/1360 periods, actual R410–2790 mm blade bounds, 450 mm sampling and 601,600 virtual cells per end. The source 1.3 mm absorber includes glue/steel; retain 1.1 mm lead with the explicitly thicker 0.2 mm total steel.
- Endcap warm package R301–2949 mm, |z|4.900–5.860 m; 250 mm rear bath with 1,584 board slots and 48 N2 branches per end.
- HCAL front apothem 3.130 m, barrel half-length 5.860 m, endcaps 6.360–7.8559 m. Retain 1.4959 m total depth. Reserve 300 mm barrel radial services, a 181 mm neck beside the endcaps, 800 mm front and 500 mm rear axial gaps.
- Cable lengths/area, bend radii, power and cooling scenarios use the shared explicit budget. The 258 kW adverse case exceeds 200 kW planning cooling; no hydraulic or thermal qualification is implied.
- LAr **does not cover |eta|=4**. Mark unbuilt forward-collar/FCal insertion reservations, with no claimed acceptance. The partial-depth barrel/endcap transition remains visible.

## Validation

28 standard-library controls pass. Full native endcaps pass shape/material/exclusive-mass/readout and 60 independent interval-gated rays; zero overlaps at 10 nm. Both signed sparse Geant4 fixtures save valid positive-energy canonical LAr hits. The actual complete LAr ECAL-only union also has zero overlaps at 10 nm and 405 material/path rays.

Retained model mass for both endcaps is 131.173 t with services, after the reviewed lead-source correction. SysArch and PhysVal independently assessed the implementation; results, corrections, hashes and failures are preserved in DES033 evidence and paired logs. The deterministic layout drawing and material/board-packing figures were rendered and inspected.

## Remaining scope

DES033 and ADR009 remain DRAFT / PROTOTYPE. Cartesian lead taper is quantified, cryostat walls and the unported rear support are explicit proxies, and actual thermal contacts, signal/HV/support openings, wall ports, headers, routing, machine interfaces, detailed HCAL, complete field solution, ACTS conversion and shower/digitization/PF performance need follow-ups. Production geometry and LAYOUT-001 are not replaced.

User request (verbatim):

> For both, the ECAL Si-W and LAr Layouts, make a single documentation PR that links and connects to the barrel / EC PRs and only summarizes the layout:
> - overall envelope viewing and drawing (the layout drawing in rz)
> - summary of the detector (including material, space and support budget)
> - concise description of EC and barrel (with links to the PR)
> - all in the description box of the PR (and separately as a 4 page pdf with identical content)
>
> This is a central entry for the reviewers, not (yet) a TDR

Coordinator interpretation: one documentation PR and four pages total cover both
candidates. A single structured source generates all prose, tables, captions and
public links into the PR description and PDF. Source snapshots retain the exact
main / component PR revisions; no open implementation stack is imported.

The repository coordination/evidence/review skills and PDF skill were applied.
Generic child contexts received explicit role instructions; native profile
loading is not claimed. Contract preparation precedes dispatch below.

- `ECAL-REVIEW-PubDoc-draft`, child `/root/layout_main_page`: authored only
  `brief.json` against source commit a53c29867130b4c36658a9aa5f6f14dd5650130f.
  Returned a concise four-page common source, public links and unsigned-state
  wording; schema/table/link/word-count checks passed. Its earlier SoftEng role
  was explicitly replaced by PubDoc. It is the author, not an independent reviewer.
- `ECAL-REVIEW-PhysVal-budget`, child `/root/lar_fit_physval`: read-only exact
  source review. Checked all nine initial hash bindings, primary mass/material
  sums, HCAL corner/envelope derivations, service/heat and coverage limitations.
  Returned corrected LAr both-end mass 131.173 t (the old 139.557 t value is
  superseded), tracker+Be inventory 2.860 t, and missing installed/HCAL budgets.
  An initial statement about a top-level Air inventory entry was withdrawn after
  exact primary-source inspection; no Air claim is retained. This child helped
  earlier LAr design work; that origin overlap is disclosed. No native jobs,
  edits, dependency installs or human sign-off were performed by this assignment.

Coordinator reconciled the facts, included the pinned solenoid material note as
source 10, and changed the endcap support shorthand to wheel support tubes.
